general_information.name: IT’S ROBERT, I THINK—MY FULL LEGAL NAME IS ON MY PAPERWORK SOMEWHERE. DO YOU MEAN THE EXACT FORM ON THE DOCUMENTS?
general_information.family_doctor_name: YES, I DO HAVE ONE—DR. PARK, I BELIEVE. IF YOU NEED THE EXACT FULL NAME, I CAN GIVE THAT TOO.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve had lost interest, fatigue, and sleep trouble. A bit of social withdrawal too.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to enjoy life again and stay active.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: 25/100 mg, one tablet three times daily.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2024, I think.; Side Effects: Just occasional nausea.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes, I’m on another one too—latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: Started that one in 2021.; Side Effects: None that I know of.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes, one more: allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: I started that in 2019.; Side Effects: None that I know of.
